title: bug: taskless-binding-notice.test.mjs stubs only moe_rpc/Invoke-MoeRpc, but the adoption boundary now calls the Unserved variants, so its bash cases fail
description:
Observed on moe/work-2026-10-24 at HEAD d9e71f7, before the main merge. `node --test scripts/tests/taskless-binding-notice.test.mjs` gives pass 1 / fail 3, failing on bash held=unknown, held=task-other and held=task-fixture. Every failure is the same: the adoption-boundary block prints nothing, notice.json is never written (ENOENT), and the stdout assert for MOE_COMMIT_REFUSED_ADOPTED_NO_BASELINE fails. The test is in the CI node-test list, so a PR to main would fail on it.

Root cause, verified with bash -x on the sliced block: CQ-F10 (13177535, 2026-10-26, task-b15bbbe5) changed the adoption boundary's get_context call. It now uses `moe_rpc_unserved` in bash (`moe_rpc_unserved() { MOE_SESSION_ID= moe_rpc "$@"; }`) and `Invoke-MoeRpcUnserved` in ps1. The test defines only `moe_rpc` and `Invoke-MoeRpc`. The Unserved call hits an undefined function and its `|| echo ''` fallback swallows that, so ADOPT_RESULT is empty and no notice is built. main's copy of the test passes against main's wrapper, which has no Unserved variant. The governor's main merge did not cause this: the failure is identical at HEAD and in the merged tree.

Fix in the TEST only: add stubs that delegate, `moe_rpc_unserved() { moe_rpc "$@"; }` for bash and an `Invoke-MoeRpcUnserved` that forwards to the `Invoke-MoeRpc` stub for ps1. Do not change scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1}. Start from the branch after governor-693b7073's merge of main lands, because that merge brings main's edits to this test file (f1c04b15, 90c8b9c3). Check `git log -1 -- scripts/tests/taskless-binding-notice.test.mjs` before editing.
definitionOfDone: `node --test scripts/tests/taskless-binding-notice.test.mjs` passes on Linux (bash cases) and on Windows (bash and powershell.exe cases; pwsh when installed), with the exit code and the pass/fail counts quoted
Only scripts/tests/taskless-binding-notice.test.mjs changes; scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1 are untouched
The stubs delegate to the existing moe_rpc / Invoke-MoeRpc fixtures, so the retained (held=task-fixture) case still asserts that no governor page is sent

implementationPlan.description:
GATE, then the two-line fix. Edit only scripts/tests/taskless-binding-notice.test.mjs. Never touch scripts/moe-agent.sh or scripts/moe-agent.ps1 (DoD 2). Never revert, stash or stage peers' dirty paths.

A. Gate, before any edit. The task text says to start only after governor-693b7073's merge of main lands. At planning time it had not landed: the merge is 3f6817f1 in an isolated worktree (parents d9e71f7 + 2c306fbf), and the governor lands it after c2a900aa, CQ-I06c and CQ-R10d1 land.
- `git merge-base --is-ancestor f1c04b15 HEAD` exits 0.
- `git log -1 --format='%h %s' -- scripts/tests/taskless-binding-notice.test.mjs` shows f1c04b15 or newer, not 4495a153.
- `grep -c 'retained holds must not repeatedly page governors' scripts/tests/taskless-binding-notice.test.mjs` prints 1. That marks main's version of the test (blob 744d086e).
- `git diff --quiet HEAD -- scripts/tests/taskless-binding-notice.test.mjs` exits 0. If it doesn't, read the diff. Continue only if its sole hunks are the two stub lines below (a resumed session of this task). Otherwise report_blocked naming the foreign hunk, and never overwrite it.
If any of the first three checks fails, the merge has not landed. Make no edit. Call moe.report_blocked with exactly this reason, which names no task ids, so nothing is auto-parsed into blockedOnTaskIds: "Waiting for governor-693b7073's merge of main into moe/work-2026-10-24 (prepared as 3f6817f1). This fix must sit on main's version of scripts/tests/taskless-binding-notice.test.mjs (f1c04b15, 90c8b9c3), which only that merge brings. Unblock with moe.set_task_status WORKING once git merge-base --is-ancestor f1c04b15 moe/work-2026-10-24 succeeds." Then end the session. Do not port main's test edits by hand.
Record `git hash-object scripts/moe-agent.sh scripts/moe-agent.ps1` for step 3.

B. Root cause. CQ-F10 (13177535) moved the adoption boundary's get_context read to the unserved twins: moe_rpc_unserved in moe-agent.sh (`moe_rpc_unserved() { MOE_SESSION_ID= moe_rpc "$@"; }`) and Invoke-MoeRpcUnserved in moe-agent.ps1. The fixture stubs only moe_rpc and Invoke-MoeRpc. The block's own error handling hides the undefined helper: sh runs `$(moe_rpc_unserved get_context "$ADOPT_ARGS" 2>/dev/null || echo "")`, and ps1 wraps the call in try/catch. So ADOPT_RESULT is empty, nothing prints, and no notice.json is written.

C. Fix: add exactly two lines. Each delegates to the existing stub, so every RPC still reaches the one NOTICE_FILE sink.
- In the bash template literal, on the line right after `moe_rpc() { ... }`:
  moe_rpc_unserved() { moe_rpc "$@"; }
- In the ps1 template literal, on the line right after the closing `}` of the `function Invoke-MoeRpc { ... }` stub:
  function Invoke-MoeRpcUnserved { param($Tool, [Alias('Args')]$RpcArgs) Invoke-MoeRpc -Tool $Tool -Args $RpcArgs }
Rules:
- Both lines sit inside JS template literals. Write "$@", never "${@}" (dollar-brace is JS interpolation), and add no backticks.
- The ps1 stub reuses the existing stub's [Alias('Args')]$RpcArgs, so the boundary's `-Args @{...}` binds without shadowing the automatic $args. Verified on powershell.exe 5.1 and pwsh 7.
- Don't give the twin its own get_context answer. Delegation is what lets the held=task-fixture case's `existsSync(notice) === false` assert catch a governor page sent through either helper (DoD 3).
- Don't copy the real helper's MOE_SESSION_ID blanking. prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs already pins that the boundary calls the twins and what they do (its moe_rpc_unserved and Invoke-MoeRpcUnserved cases).
- If `grep -c 'moe_rpc_unserved()' scripts/tests/taskless-binding-notice.test.mjs` already prints 1, the stubs arrived with the merge. Skip the edit and say so in complete_task.
- Use the Edit tool, with old_string limited to the anchor lines. Never include the writeFileSync line that prepends the BOM escape: the Edit tool turns a backslash-u escape into the literal character. Afterwards `LC_ALL=C grep -nP '[^[:ascii:]]' scripts/tests/taskless-binding-notice.test.mjs` must print nothing.
Report scripts/tests/taskless-binding-notice.test.mjs in complete_step.modifiedFiles.

implementationPlan.description:
ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW of this task's diff. Run each check and quote its result.
1. Scope (DoD 2).
   - `git diff f1c04b15 -- scripts/tests/taskless-binding-notice.test.mjs` shows only the two added stub lines. If the landed merge resolved this file differently from main's f1c04b15 version, diff against the merge commit's copy instead.

   - complete_step.modifiedFiles names only the test file.
2. Mutation proof, in a scratch copy outside the repo. Never edit scripts/moe-agent.* in the shared tree.
   - Set up: `M=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$M/scripts/tests"; cp scripts/moe-agent.sh scripts/moe-agent.ps1 "$M/scripts/"; cp scripts/tests/taskless-binding-notice.test.mjs "$M/scripts/tests/"`.
   - Run `(cd "$M" && node --test scripts/tests/taskless-binding-notice.test.mjs)` once per mutant, restoring the copy between them.
   - (a) Delete the `moe_rpc_unserved() {` line from the scratch test. All 3 bash cases must fail with the original symptom: ENOENT on notice.json, or empty stdout.
   - (b) In the scratch moe-agent.sh, remove ` && [ "$ADOPTED_BINDING" != retained ]`. Only held=task-fixture may fail, with "retained holds must not repeatedly page governors". This proves DoD 3: the delegate keeps the page observable.
   - Both must go red; quote the failing case names. Then `rm -rf "$M"`. At planning, mutant (b) went red on Linux exactly this way.
3. Checklist.
   - Concurrent runs are safe: each case has its own mkdtemp dir and NOTICE_FILE, and the stubs hold no state.
   - The finally block still removes temp files on every path.
   - A future rename of either twin fails loudly again instead of passing.
   - The ps1 BOM write line is unchanged.
   - The file is still ASCII-only (step 1's grep).

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Port main's f1c04b15 and 90c8b9c3 test edits into this task now. Rejected: the task text says to start after the merge lands. A git merge-file simulation (base f3060b81, ours = main plus stubs, theirs = main) showed the later merge would still come out clean, as main plus stubs. But this task's commit would then carry main's lines and blur their provenance. (2) A standalone twin stub that answers get_context itself. Rejected: it would bypass the one NOTICE_FILE sink. If the boundary ever sent its page through the twin, the retained no-page assert would pass vacuously. (3) Point the wrapper back at moe_rpc. Rejected: CQ-F10 requires the unserved read (no served-context receipt), and DoD 2 forbids wrapper edits. (4) Mirror the MOE_SESSION_ID blanking in the stub. Unnecessary: prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs already pins it.
